t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They could not find a definite pattern to which gnomes were worth more points. Any pattern they found seemed to change in each round. They were not sure if they were correct in what they were thinking.

vb_textbox.text: At first, I did think there was a correlation between the colour of the gnome to how many points I received, but this seemed to change as we progressed to the next game. I then found that when +5 appeared, if I selected the left gnome (regardless of colour) then I seemed to get more points (double figures every time). This seemed to work well, until the 3rd game, when it didn't seem to work. In the 3rd game, I tried to choose the gnomes with the pointy hats, which appeared to give more points at first but then seemed to change, so I don't really know for sure what (if any at all) correlation is present.
